name: Savings Bank
description: Marble floor, a ticking clock and a very quiet queue. Open Tuesdays and Thursdays, in theory.
greeting: A pensioner is updating her passbook.
A brochure: 'Save for your own sauna!'

hello: Good day. How may we help?
Your ID, please. Yes, even though I know you.
deposit: Very sensible. Money grows slowly here.
withdraw: Here you are. Count it, please.
Don't spend it all at the Trokari.
hired: Welcome to the bank. Dress code applies.
juho: Juho has audited this bank twice. Voluntarily.
He found a two-cent error in 1998. We still hear about it.
Juho brings his own calculator. And a spare.

actions.label: Let Juho check your finances
actions.description: Juho knows his finances to the last cent, and somehow every split bill ends up in his favour. For a fee, he will find the cents you are missing.

requires.message: Juho is busy recounting his own savings. Come back next week.

then.message: Juho studies your bank account. "Zero. Well, at least it's easy to count." He doesn't charge you. This time.

do.message: Juho goes through your statements with a ruler and finds €{gain} the bank "forgot". His fee: €{cost}, rounded up. "Rounding down is how they get you."
Juho moves your savings to a slightly better account: €{gain} more. He charges €{cost} and asks for the receipt back.
Juho finds €{gain} in fees you never needed to pay. His own fee of €{cost}, however, is non-negotiable.
